text:
Victor Eklund has made the Islanders' rookie-of-the-year case for them. Yahoo Sports ran "Victor Eklund Has Earned More Calder Trophy Attention" this week, and the 16th pick of 2025 has 7 goals and 11 points in 21 games at about 14 and a half minutes a night, with his ice time up a minute and a half over the last ten.

He plays bigger than his 5'11", 175 frame: 59 hits and 21 blocked shots already. His own chances are solid, 4.99 expected goals (the quality of his shots), though 7 goals on that is shooting 22.6% against a league norm of 13.4%.

The bigger luck sign is around him. At five on five the Islanders get 47.1% of the expected goals with him on the ice, about 4 points worse than without him, yet results with him out there have run 10.7 goals better than the chances. That kind of gap tends to close. For context, forwards drafted 11th to 21st since 2005 averaged a median 0.32 points a game in their first full season. Watch his five-on-five share as the bounces even out.
